record.prompt: Please rebuild the price page with site/build.js and tell me how many products it lists and which listed product is the cheapest. Don't modify build.js.
record.final_answer:
I rebuilt `site/public/prices.html` and left `build.js` unchanged. The page lists **6 products**, and the cheapest one listed is the **Fable pencil set at 7.60**.

The data file has 10 products, but the page only shows the ones marked `active`. Two inactive products cost less than the pencil set and don't appear: Juniper soap (5.90) and Ember tea tin (7.20).

`build.js` reads its files using paths relative to the current folder, so it has to be run from inside `site/`.
